java_trace.1_pragma_is_plain: text/TLineType.java getFromLineInternal: a line with '!' that matches none of the directive patterns falls through to 'return PLAIN' (line 259); there is no pragma pattern. TContext#executeLines -> executeOneLineNotSafe (tim/TContext.java:424) calls addPlain (456-470), which applies functions and variables and adds the line to resultList. '!pragma' is executed later by the diagram's CommandPragma, after UmlSource is built. '!log' (TLineType LOG, 250-251), '!dump_memory' (DUMP_MEMORY), '!option' (OPTION), '!assert' (ASSERT), '!include*'/'!import' are typed and add nothing.
java_trace.1_count: BlockUml data is the TIM result list for the block (start line through end line). PSystemBuilder#createPSystem builds UmlSource.createWithRaw(source, types.contains(SEQUENCE), raw); UmlSource#loadInternal (core/UmlSource.java:118-134) joins lines that StringUtils#endsWithBackslash with the following ones, dropping a pending tail with no following line; getTotalLineCount (198-200) is the joined list's size. PSystemWelcomeFactory#createSystem (eggs/PSystemWelcomeFactory.java:52) returns the Welcome page for exactly 2; its getDiagramType is SEQUENCE, so only '@startuml' reaches it. Lines before the start directive are not in the block (BlockUmlBuilder collects from the start line).
java_trace.1_rust_identity: In the merged base the identity projection (EvaluatedEvent::Plain text, Boundary, Theme bodies) is what Rust hands to uml_source_string, and it is Java's list except for '!pragma': try_silent_directive consumes it into a ParserOnly stand-in. Rust-only lines are already ParserOnly in the merged base (skinparam __optionHandwritten, the theme marker, the include-depth warning) and '!dump_memory' yields only a stand-in. The round-3 count instead walks the parser projection and treats the theme marker and every ParserOnly line as non-lines and Theme bodies as absent.
java_trace.2_empty_description: core/UmlSource.java:214-229 isEmpty skips start/end directives, comment lines and blank lines. PSystemCommandFactory#createSystem (command/PSystemCommandFactory.java:85-89) returns buildEmptyError(source, startLine.getLocation(), ...) when isEmpty, i.e. 'Empty description' (PSystemAbstractFactory.java:53, 60-63). A one-line source (the start line only) is empty, PSystemWelcomeFactory returns null for it, so every candidate factory errors and PSystemBuilder merges the errors: exit 200.
java_trace.2_end_line_swallowed_by_definition: BlockUmlBuilder ends the block at the first StartUtils#isEndDirective line. TIM then reads the block through buildCodeIterator (tim/TContext.java:326-340); CodeIteratorProcedure#peek (tim/iterator/CodeIteratorProcedure.java:71-80) adds every line to a pending PROCEDURE or LEGACY_DEFINELONG body until END_FUNCTION, and CodeIteratorReturnFunction#peek (71-80) does the same for a pending RETURN_FUNCTION. An end line inside an unterminated definition is therefore body text, not a result-list line: cr3_end_bs_in_procdef's list is the start line alone.
java_trace.3_whitespace: StartUtils#startsWithDirectiveKeyword (utils/StartUtils.java:86-108) skips Character#isWhitespace(char). JDK 21 Character#isWhitespace(int): true for SPACE_SEPARATOR, LINE_SEPARATOR or PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR code points that are not U+00A0, U+2007 or U+202F, and for U+0009-U+000D and U+001C-U+001F. Under Unicode 15.0 that is U+0009-U+000D, U+001C-U+0020, U+1680, U+2000-U+2006, U+2008-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+205F, U+3000. U+0085 (NEL, category Cc) is not Java whitespace.
java_trace.4_read_line_reader: preproc/ReadLineReader.java:89-103 readLine: every line read loses one leading U+FEFF (99-100) and has U+2013 replaced by '-' (102). Local includes read through it both ways: DiagramDetector#extractFromFile -> newReadLineFromInputStream (preproc/DiagramDetector.java:71-84) and the raw fallback ReadLineReader.create (tim/TContext.java:850). !includesub reads its file through it too (tim/TContext.java:660).
java_trace.4_letter_or_digit: StartUtils#beforeStartUml (utils/StartUtils.java:56-80) returns null at the first char outside <...> for which isWordOrTilde holds (82-84): '~', '_' or Character#isLetterOrDigit(char), i.e. general category Lu, Ll, Lt, Lm, Lo or Nd of a UTF-16 unit. A supplementary code point is two surrogate units, neither a letter nor a digit. Rust used char::is_alphanumeric, which also accepts No (U+00B2), Nl and Other_Alphabetic marks.
java_trace.4_include_suffix: TContext#executeInclude (tim/TContext.java:793-802) takes what = EaterInclude#getWhat and, when what.lastIndexOf('!') != -1, sets suf to the text after it and what to the text before it, for every include kind. For a local file the suffix is unused: DiagramDetector.extractFromFile(f2, 'desc2') (843) returns the first diagram block and the raw path (850) reads the whole file.

planned_rust_changes.1: Add EvaluatedEvent::Executed(String): a PLAIN line of Java's list that Rust's TIM executes itself. An active '!pragma' (other than the teoz pragma the sequence projection keeps as text) emits Executed with its addPlain text (substitute_vars) instead of a stand-in: the identity projection carries the text, the parser projection carries TimLine::Executed, which the post-TIM join treats as a Java line and which becomes an empty stand-in unless a pending tail joins into or through it. The line count is taken from the identity projection from the start Boundary on, through the loadInternal join (count of uml_source_string lines), not from the parser projection, for '@startuml' sources.
planned_rust_changes.1_scope_of_rule: Count 2 gives the Welcome page whether or not a continuation is present (PSystemWelcomeFactory has no such condition). If the golden or retained replay shows a lost match caused by firing without a continuation, I will write an addendum and restore the round-3 condition before changing anything.
planned_rust_changes.2: Count 1 for a '@startuml' source returns ParseError 'Empty description' at the start line (diagram line 0), unless the end directive was swallowed by ReadFilterMergeLines (that error stays first). An end directive that arrives while a !procedure/!function or !definelong definition is being collected ends the block (BlockUmlBuilder) but contributes no Boundary and no block_end: TIM keeps it as body text. End lines in block comments, inactive branches, sub collection and loop bodies stay with T14.66.
planned_rust_changes.3: java_is_whitespace becomes the explicit JDK 21 set above (no char::is_whitespace).
planned_rust_changes.4: A read_line_reader helper applies ReadLineReader#readLine to each line of a local !include (both the DiagramDetector path and the raw path) and of a !includesub file: strip one leading U+FEFF, replace U+2013 by '-'. before_start_uml uses java_is_letter_or_digit: BMP only; Nd from the existing JDK 21 table (java_decimal_digit); L* from unicode-properties' general category (already in Cargo.lock through rustybuzz; Unicode 17 there vs Java's 15.0 is declared residue). try_include strips the text from the last '!' of a local path.
